name: 27377 · Whitsett, NC
findings: ZIP 27377 (Whitsett) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 4 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27377 (Whitsett) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
